summary.zh: 调用多家图像模型生成或改写图片

description.zh: 支持文生图、参考图生图和多种画幅比例，也能读取提示词文件批量出图。兼容 OpenAI、Azure、Google、OpenRouter、DashScope、Seedream、Replicate 等接口。需要自备所选服务的 API Key。
description.en: Creates images from text or reference images with aspect ratio control, and can batch a saved prompt file. Works with OpenAI, Azure, Google, OpenRouter, DashScope, Seedream and similar APIs. Bring your own API key.
